changes.comment: Add filterMode: "immediate" | "apply" | "excel". Excel mode opens an unfiltered column with every value ticked and a select-all, stores no filter when everything is still ticked, and refuses an empty selection (canApply), since the empty array already means unfiltered; clear() re-ticks everything in that mode. useFilterDraft gains excel, setAll, canApply and canClear, and takes the column's loaded options. deferApply is kept as the older spelling of filterMode: "apply"
